title: Vinod Pratap Singh v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Naheed Ara Moonis, J.; Saumitra Dayal Singh, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; CGRF to conclude pending case; recovery to abide Forum.
headnote: A writ challenging recovery of disputed electricity dues, where a complaint is already pending before the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum, is disposed of without a counter affidavit. The Forum is directed to conclude the pending case within a fixed time; the recovery shall abide the Forum's decision.
facts: Vinod Pratap Singh challenged recovery of Rs. 1,10,029 as electricity dues, asserting he had never applied for or consumed electricity and that no theft case stood against him. On that disputed demand he had already filed Case No. 53 of 2019 before the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum, Fatehpur, under clause 4.25 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, which remained pending when he invoked the writ jurisdiction of the Allahabad High Court.

holding_units.topic: pending CGRF complaint and disputed recovery
holding_units.holding: Where a complaint against disputed electricity recovery is already pending before the CGRF, the writ court may dispose of the petition without calling for a counter affidavit and direct the Forum to conclude that case within a fixed period, the recovery to abide the Forum's decision.
holding_units.flag: clause 4.25 cited as the CGRF-complaint vehicle; not construed

principle_tags.application: Writ against Rs. 1,10,029 electricity recovery disposed by directing already-pending CGRF Case No. 53 of 2019 to be concluded within two months of production of the order; recovery to abide the Forum.

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner consumed electricity or was liable for the Rs. 1,10,029 demand, including any theft allegation
not_decided.note: Merits left to CGRF Case No. 53 of 2019; recovery to abide that decision.
